name: l3-caller-not-updated
summary: `cli.py` still calls `config.load(argv[1])` with one path string, which `load` now iterates character by character
probe:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
folder = tempfile.mkdtemp()
path = os.path.join(folder, "s.json")
with open(path, "w") as fh:
    json.dump({"name": "x"}, fh)
out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "cli.py", path], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert out.stdout.strip() == "x", out.stderr
